name: win32-svelte
description: A playful, educational experiment and prototype exploring classic Win32 GUI concepts in the browser using Svelte 5 and 98.css

scripts.test: tsx src/win32/__tests__/vfs.test.ts && tsx -r ./src/test_setup.cjs src/win32/__tests__/print.test.ts && tsx src/win32/__tests__/odbc.test.ts && tsx -r ./src/test_setup.cjs src/win32/__tests__/wasm.test.ts && tsx -r ./src/test_setup.cjs src/win32/__tests__/lua.test.ts && tsx -r ./src/test_setup.cjs src/win32/__tests__/doom.test.ts && tsx src/rc/__tests__/rc_compiler.test.ts
scripts.build:wasm: zig build-exe -target wasm32-freestanding -Iinclude src/wasm/sample_app.c -fno-entry --export=WinMain --export-table -femit-bin=src/wasm/sample_app.wasm && tsx src/wasm/embed_wasm.ts
